title: Ezekiel's Symbolic Act: The Sign of Exile
description: The Lord commands the prophet Ezekiel to perform a dramatic symbolic act: he is to pack his belongings like an exile, break through the wall, and carry it out into the darkness with his face covered. This action serves as a sign for the house of Israel, especially targeting the prince in Jerusalem, who will be caught in the Lord's net, taken to Babylon without seeing the land, and die there. The people and their helpers will be scattered among the nations, but a small remnant will be spared to recount their abominations, so that they may know that He is the Lord [ref:Ezekiel 12:1-16|Ezekiel 12:1-16].
